title: Gemini Evidence Intake and Development CI Automation Contracts

phases.objective: Provide executable repository-native specification and CI contracts that validate their internal references and generate deterministic read-only development work packets without runtime mutation authority.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Run the Spec-local contract validator from the repository candidate tree
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The manifest, development contract, CI contract, dependency graph, evidence references, sole-writer policy, no-secret checks, and completion consistency produce a successful structured integrity report.
steps: Load the Spec manifest, development automation contract, CI automation contract, and completion state from the exact candidate tree.

Validate file presence, immutable identifiers, cross-references, dependency acyclicity, task and acceptance coverage, Test Family bindings, Pipeline evidence bindings, writer policy, and no-secret assertions.
Emit the bounded mad4b.spec014.contract-integrity-report.v1 report and fail closed on any finding.
assertions: The report declares ok=true and secrets_included=false.
All development and CI references resolve without cycles or orphan requirements.
The contract remains specification-only and does not create mutation authority.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Generate a read-only work packet for T001 from the connected development and CI contracts
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A deterministic work packet identifies the task, wave, requirements, acceptance criteria, operation paths, scope, Test Families, Pipelines, gates, blockers, evidence, resume key, and plan hash without executing a mutation.
steps: Read T001, WAVE-00, its dependencies, Work Map state, and applicable CI Test Families from the exact candidate tree.
Calculate task readiness and explicit blockers without inventing approval or changing task state.
Emit a structured work packet with a stable plan hash, work-packet ID, authority boundary, rollback posture, and secrets_included=false.
assertions: The packet references only declared Requirements, Acceptance Criteria, Operation Paths, Test Families, and Pipelines.
The packet reports blocked or ready truthfully from current evidence and does not treat the contract as mutation authority.
The same canonical inputs produce the same plan hash.

phases.objective: Activate project-specific Spec Contract Gate, phase governance, and canonical CI summary pipelines after the contracts pass review.
blockers: The Draft Spec and CI contracts require authoritative exact-head validation and review.
No new project-specific GitHub Actions workflow is authorized by this specification branch.

planned_e2e_journey.entrypoint: Open an implementation PR bound to one development work packet
planned_e2e_journey.terminal_outcome: Changed-scope gates, phase journeys, canonical evidence, and exact-head identity are successful for the declared task.
steps: Validate the work packet and changed paths against the selected task.
Run applicable Test Families and produce exact-candidate canonical evidence.
Block merge when scope, contracts, tests, or evidence are incomplete.

phases.objective: Add diagnostic sharding, ordered progress, stale-evidence rejection, generated-artifact repair candidates, dead-letter repair, and manual fallback evidence.
blockers: Operational CI pipelines are not implemented.
Generated artifact roots and sole-writer authorization policy require implementation review.

planned_e2e_journey.entrypoint: Introduce a bounded test failure or stale generated artifact on an exact candidate head
planned_e2e_journey.terminal_outcome: CI provides canonical failure evidence, exact rerun or repair coordinates, prevents unsafe remote write, and verifies the corrected new head.
steps: Run diagnostic shards and the ordered sequential suite.
Produce an exact-head repair candidate when generated output is stale.
Verify that only an explicitly authorized writer may commit the approved root and that CI reruns on the pushed SHA.

phases.objective: Run non-sensitive Gemini and evidence-intake pilot cohorts with exact release evidence, budgets, privacy policy, manual fallback, and rollback.
blockers: Runtime, provider, privacy, budget, model, review, and pilot implementation waves are not complete.

planned_e2e_journey.actor: Authorized internal pilot user and reviewer
planned_e2e_journey.entrypoint: Submit a permitted non-sensitive evidence item to the canary intake
planned_e2e_journey.terminal_outcome: The item is preserved, analyzed or manually routed, reviewed, linked, measured, and rollback-safe under the selected cohort.
steps: Submit and read back an idempotent intake and canonical evidence record.
Process through the allowed provider policy or manual fallback and validate the structured proposal.
Complete human review, downstream linkage, metrics, and rollback verification.

phases.objective: Verify production/main parity, health, queue and worker state, active model/prompt/policy versions, budgets, runtime smoke, fallback, rollback, and completion evidence.
blockers: Canary acceptance and production release authority do not exist yet.
No production deployment, migration ledger, or runtime readback has been executed.

planned_e2e_journey.entrypoint: Promote an exact verified release candidate through the governed deployment path
planned_e2e_journey.terminal_outcome: Production is proven to run the intended release with safe provider policy, healthy queues, bounded budgets, manual fallback, rollback posture, and complete closeout evidence.
steps: Verify exact-head CI, migrations when applicable, deployment parity, and active feature configuration.
Run bounded production health and smoke readback without exposing sensitive data.
Verify manual fallback, rollback, post-merge audit, and completion manifest consistency.
